newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures erase loss as bonds firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures erase loss as bonds firm.

text.p: July 17 - Sept S&P 500 stock index futures bounced off minor technical support to recover most of their opening losses triggered by heavy dealer selling. The contract fell to 937.00 on the open, just below an intraday low from late Wednesday, then trimmed most of the decline on light short-covering and firmness in Treasury bonds, floor traders said.
